development.what: the ARC-AGI-1 training split: the vocabulary was written against it and the library is learned from the programs that solved it (the corpus verdicts)

heldOut.what: the ARC-AGI-1 evaluation split; nothing in capability/grid-dsl.mjs was tuned on it (this bench header), and a library refuses any corpus that is not a training verdict

developmentRecords: none: the evaluation split is held out; the library was learned from training programs only
statement: On the ARC-AGI-1 evaluation split, 400 tasks, at 3000 ms per task, 2 workers and 2 attempts per task, arms run one at a time: the grid search with a library learned from 156 solved training tasks (1 macros, a learned search order, run as a portfolio: the hand ordered search for the first 2250 ms, then the learned order with the macros) solved 68, and without it 69 and 71 in 2 runs (run to run noise 2 tasks, 2 tasks flipped between them). Against the better no-library run the margin is -3; against the first no-library run the library newly solved 1 and lost 2. At attempt 1 alone: library 68, no library 69 and 71. Macros used in at least one right answer: 0 of 1. Mean ms per task: library 2883.76, no library 2842.43 and 2846.81; timed out: library 327, no library 324 and 322. The bar (library above the better no-library run by more than the noise) is MISSED. Latencies were measured on a machine shared with other builders.
